# External Libraries

## Third-party Libraries

- **tinygltf** ([GitHub](https://github.com/syoyo/tinygltf)): 2.9.7, used for reading GLB/GLTF files
  - **stb_image** ([GitHub](https://github.com/nothings/stb)): 2.30, used by tinygltf
  - **json** ([GitHub])(https://github.com/nlohmann/json): 3.12.0,  used by tinygltf
  - **rapidjson** ([GitHub](https://github.com/Tencent/rapidjson)): 1.1.0, used by tinygltf
- **libnpy** ([GitHub](https://github.com/matajoh/libnpy)): 1.5.3, used for writing NPZ files
- **libboard**: 2007 version (not the latest 0.9.6), used for writing SVG files
- **happly.h** ([GitHub](https://github.com/nmwsharp/happly)): 1.1.0 with my changes, used for reading/writing PLY files
- **nanoflann.h** ([GitHub](https://github.com/jlblancoc/nanoflann)): 1.21.1, used for KD-tree nearest-neighbor search
- **tinycolormap.h** ([GitHub](https://github.com/yuki-koyama/tinycolormap)): 0.8.0, used for color maps
- **blossom5** ([Website](https://pub.ista.ac.at/~vnk/software.html)): 2.05, used for minimum-weight matching
- **cxxopts** ([GitHub](https://github.com/jarro2783/cxxopts)): 3.3.1, used for command-line option parsing
- **toml11** ([GitHub](https://github.com/ToruNiina/toml11)): 4.4.0, used for reading command options
- **ufbx** ([GitHub](https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx)): 0.23.0, used for loading FBX files
- **OpenMesh** ([Website](https://www.graphics.rwth-aachen.de/software/openmesh/)): 11.0, used for mesh collapse
- **termcolor** ([GitHub](https://github.com/ikalnytskyi/termcolor)): 2.1.0, used for colored terminal output
